title: orchestration-playbook-for-sdk-adoption-kits-and-release-notes
creator: Maya Lin
project: SDK & API Launch - Function Calling + Streaming
description: Consolidated orchestration playbook to coordinate cross-functional launch activities for the SDK/API surface (function calling + structured output + streaming). Purpose: reduce launch friction, ensure release notes are accurate and localized, provide a curated sample kit for each language, and wire telemetry for adoption metrics and regression detection.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes draft signed off by PM, Engineering lead, and Legal
Language-specific sample kits (Python, JS, Go, Java) published in samples repo with CI checks
Docs page for structured output + streaming patterns + function-calling best practices live in Docs (stable)
Telemetry events instrumented and validated in staging dashboard (latency, error-rate, sample-usage, fallback-rate)
Canary rollout plan validated with two internal customers and one partner pilot
tasks: Draft release notes template and changelog entries (include migration section and example responses)
Assemble sample kit: minimal quickstart + 3 realistic app snippets per language (chat streaming, function-calling orchestration, structured JSON output)
Coordinate with SDK infra (ENG-5421) to ensure streaming backpressure story surfaces in samples
Get design review for sample UX and screenshots (DES-210)
Prepare API compatibility matrix and map deprecated behaviors
Create telemetry spec and event names; handoff to infra for instrumentation
Run internal doc freeze review and schedule translations for 3 locales
Set up canary cadence and rollback triggers with SRE
Prepare support runbook and FAQ for customer support reps
Publish GA announcement draft and partner enablement brief
updates: 2026-02-14: Kickoff — aligned PM, Eng, Design, SRE, Legal on scope. Action: Eng to provide runtime compatibility matrix by 2026-02-21.
2026-02-21: ENG delivered kernel/compat matrix; identified two minor breaking behaviors for older client SDKs — decision: add compatibility shim and document migration steps (ENG-2178).
2026-02-27: Design review completed. Designer recommended adding 'observability hooks' section for sample apps; added to sample kit scope and story points +1.
2026-03-01: Release notes draft uploaded to Confluence. Legal provided wording constraints for enterprise telemetry; follow-up with Legal on opt-in language (legal@redwood).
2026-03-05: Sample kit first pass (Python & JS) committed in github.com/redwood/samples#pr-482 — awaiting code reviews from SDK leads.
2026-03-09: Telemetry spec blocked by infra dependency (ENG-3320) — SRE scheduled catch-up 2026-03-11 to unblock. Added temporary fallback measurements using proxy logs.
2026-03-11: Canary pilot scheduled with Partner A (payments platform) for 2026-03-18. Partner onboarding doc created and shared.
2026-03-12: Docs reviewer notes: expand structured-output section with validator snippets and error-handling patterns. Assigned to docs writer Priya Narang.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal alpha: feature flag enabled for 15% of internal traffic + partner sandboxes. 2) Partner pilot: Partner A + Partner B for two weeks. 3) Gradual canary: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 72 hours with rollback on error-rate > 0.5% or latency spike > 2x baseline. 4) GA: open rollout with rate-limits ramp and communication to customers via newsletter and partner briefing.
postmortem_plan: If rollout triggers rollback, run immediate incident writeup: timeline, telemetry snapshots, root cause, mitigations, and checklist updates. Postmortem to include sample usage failures and documentation gaps; update samples and docs within one sprint and schedule follow-up verification with partner pilots.
